title: Context
description: A per-stack context.yaml. The top level is open: a project keeps whatever keys it needs. Only the keys the plugin's skills read are declared.

verify.description: Commands that prove a change in this repository holds. The plugin's commit gate runs them in order from the repository root at every spec commit; deliver-spec runs them by hand only when no gate checked the commit.

label.description: What the stage is called in the report (build, test, lint).

command.description: Shell command, run from the repository root; a command needing another directory carries its own cd.

when_present.description: Path relative to the repository root the command needs; absent path = the stage is skipped and reported, never failed.

gate.description: Who gates a spec commit. plugin (the default when no context declares it): the plugin's PreToolUse hook runs the verify stages. project: the repository runs its own commit gate and the plugin's hook steps aside. git: the commit-msg hook that hooks/install-git-hook.py writes into each clone runs the stages, for every agent and for commits typed by hand; the plugin's hook steps aside where that hook is installed. Every teammate needs plugin 2.8.0 or later before a context declares git. Declare it in one context; two different values block every spec commit.

evidence_roots.description: Qualifiers a spec's evidence may use ('name:path/to/file:12'), each mapped to a path relative to the repository root. review-spec resolves a qualified citation there when the path exists, otherwise accepts it unchecked.
